name: Something in the Rows
summary: Something in the Rows is a first-person survival horror game for one to four players, set on Halloway Farms. In 1934 Thomas Halloway struck a bargain for rain, and the price was his family; when the last of the Halloways dies in 2016, the farm's gate locks and the thing in the corn is set free. Players search a corn maze that is laid out anew every run, recover eight wards guarded by puzzles and rituals across the farm, the graveyard and a mansion of more than seventy rooms, mend the broken ones, and escape through the gate while the Gleaner hunts them. Players carry no weapons, only a lantern that can fail and limited stamina, and the Gleaner tracks footsteps and, in online co-op, voices over proximity voice chat. Downed players wake in a coffin and must be dug out by their teammates. The game has multiple endings.
